Peninsula Vet Care: Emergency and Referral Hospital

Peninsula Vet Care: Emergency and Referral Hospital

4.90 / 5

Overview

Whether visiting us for an emergency or you have been referred to one of our specialists, Peninsula Vet Emergency and Referral Hospital ensure the highest level of personalised care for you and your pet. Our aim, wherever possible, is to return your pets care to their regular Veterinarian with guidance and support as required.

We are committed to building a lifelong relationship with both you and your pet, all while enriching the lives of every animal we see. With nearly 60 vets in our family, you will have access to an unrivalled wealth of experience, broad knowledge base and expertise. This allows us to see, diagnose and provide treatment to your pet all under one roof at Peninsula Vet Care.

Illness and injury can strike at any time.  Therefore, we have the most extensive opening hours at each location with linked patient histories so you can visit any of our hospitals. Our services range from diagnosis and treatment of complex illnesses, behavioural issues, advanced surgical procedures, ultrasound, skin conditions, pocket pets, dentistry, vaccinations and more.

Routine Services

  • 24/7 Emergency Hospital
  • Referral Surgery
  • Referral Internal Medicine
  • Onsite Pathology
  • Advanced Imaging
  • Clinical Immunology

Customer reviews

During a very stressful time, our dog had broken his shoulder . The vets and staff made the experience extremely comforting. They were all so loving and caring. The procedure was fully explained. And post Op we were kept fully informed.
Connie C.
"Everyone was extremely friendly and listening to our concerns with our dog. Misty was thoroughly examined several times while taking into consideration her anxiety. Gave us all the options and allowed us to chose what best suited us. Made sure we understood what was happening and her medication requirements. Would recommend taking your pet here in an emergency."
Sharlene M.
Our very loved West Highland White Terrier required knee surgery. We received great service, were kept informed and our beautiful Hamish received excellent care. When we collected him after 48 hours, despite the surgery being major, he was calm and comfortable. This is the standard you want when you entrust your family members to others.
Tracey A.
